For a Level 1 appeal about extending care, you must contact the Quality Improvement Organization by noon of the day before the effective date on the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage. (Evidence of Coverage 2026, plan H5141-004, Chapter: If you have a problem or complaint > How to make a Level 2 appeal)
